package_name.description: The name of the package being backed up or referenced in comments.

cron_schedule.description: The cron schedule expression for when the backup job runs.

cron_user.description: The system user account under which the cron job executes.

binary_path.description: The full path to the ldap-git-backup executable.

slapcat_path.description: The full path to the slapcat executable used in the pre-check.

cron_comment_msg.description: The commit message used for the git commit during the backup.
